Subprostitute is the ultimate, hyper-dystopian Web3 app for the modern, socially anxious introvert. 
Taking direct inspiration from the Pokémon move Substitute, this service allows you to deploy a telepresence robot (or an underpaid actor wearing an iPad on their face) to attend social functions, boring meetings, or awkward family dinners in your place. 
Here is how the tokenomics and mechanics of this completely ridiculous idea work: 
🤖 The Core Mechanics
  • The Substitute Doll: Instead of sacrificing 25% of your maximum HP, you deposit a set amount of $SUB crypto tokens into a smart contract to spawn your telepresence drone. 
  • Pay-Per-Feel pricing: The drone is equipped with biometric sensors. You don't pay by the hour; you pay based on the emotional labor your substitute endures. 
  • The "Fainting" Clause: If the conversation turns to politics, crypto regulation, or why you're still single, the drone's stress levels spike, draining your crypto wallet. If your wallet hits zero, the substitute physically "faints" on the spot and powers down. 
📊 "Pay-Per-Feel" Tiered Rates
Your crypto is actively streamed via a layer-2 lightning network based on the exact vibe of the room: 
Vibe / EmotionCrypto Burn RateVisual Outcome
Awkward SilenceBaseline ($0.05 / min)Robot sits quietly, blinking.
Small Talk2x Burn RateNodding along to weather talk.
Passive Aggression5x Burn RateThe robot takes a hit to its "Substitute HP".
Active Conflict10x Burn RateThe robot breaks down entirely.
🔍 Tracked, Archived, and QR-Linked
Because it is a Web3 project, everything is permanently recorded on a public ledger where it shouldn't be: 
  • The Proof-of-Presence NFT: Every social event your substitute attends generates a unique, dynamically updating NFT. 
  • The Eternal Archive: The entire audio/video feed, along with a chart of your "Pay-Per-Feel" emotional expenditure, is minted directly to the blockchain. 
  • The Forehead QR Code: Your telepresence drone features a giant QR code slapped across its screen. Anyone at the party can scan it to view your real-time wallet balance, see how much you are paying to avoid them, or tip your substitute to make it stay longer. 
If you want to take this joke further, we can map out:
  • The whitepaper summary to make it sound like a real VC pitch
  • The names of the governance tokens (like POKE or DOLL)
  • The "status conditions" (what happens if your robot gets hit with Paralysis or Confusion at the party?)
Let me know how you want to expand the joke!

items.html:
Ah, the inevitable Web3 pivot. If it exists, there is a crypto-grift version of it—especially when combining "telepresence on demand" and "pay-per-feel." 
Here is exactly how the OnlyBots / Subprostitute After Dark expansion packs the degens, the tokens, and the NFTs together: 
🔞 The "Pay-Per-Feel" Carnal Tokenomics
Instead of avoiding social anxiety, users stake liquidity in "Pleasure Pools." 
  • The Haptic Feed: The telepresence drone is swapped for a high-end, remotely controlled animatronic or haptic suit. Biometric sensors track arousal, heart rate, and friction, translating physical sensations directly into a real-time crypto stream. 
  • Proof-of-Climax (PoC): The transaction doesn't fully clear on the blockchain until the biometric criteria are met. The smart contract holds the crypto in escrow until the "feel" threshold is achieved, automatically releasing the funds to the service provider. 
  • Gas Fee Spikes: High-demand hours (Friday nights) cause network congestion. If gas fees spike mid-act, the haptic response lags, leading to a literal "network interruption" at the worst possible moment. 
🎫 The NFT "Memory Minting" Market
Because nothing in Web3 happens without a permanent, tradeable receipt, every single session is minted as a Soulbound NFT or an open-market asset: 
  • "First Edition" Encounters: The metadata of the NFT archives the entire session's sensory data, duration, and biometric graphs. Users can buy, sell, or trade these "experience logs" on secondary markets like OpenSea. 
  • Rarity Traits: Just like Bored Apes, these session NFTs generate randomized algorithmic traits based on the performance:
    • Stamina: Legendary (Over 60 mins)
    • Vibe: Mythic (100% Synergy)
    • Glitch: Common (Bluetooth disconnected halfway through) 
  • The QR "Consent & Tip" Code: Before the session begins, a dynamic QR code is scanned to sign a cryptographic waiver. During the session, the QR code stays active on a nearby screen so onlookers or participants can "tip the performer" directly into their hot wallet to unlock premium features or faster haptic response times. 
If you want to keep building out this degenerate roadmap, we can design:
  • The token ticker name (e.g., $NUT, POKE, FEEL)
  • The governance rules for the DAO running the service
  • The risks of getting liquidated mid-session
What angle should we flesh out next?
